MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly for trial by jury.

Appearances:
DAVID G. MENDEZ, Esq. on behalf of plaintiff EGH, LLC
LAMIN KANTORA, defendant in pro per

After meeting in Dept. 504, the parties settled. Terms of the settlement are as follows:

Judgment in favor of plaintiff EGH, LLC and against defendant LAMIN KANTORA for restitution of premises located at 761 Minna St., #13, San Francisco, CA. 94103. Writ to issue immediately, however there is a stay of execution until 9:00 a.m. on October 27, 2004. Each side to bear own fees and costs. Plaintiff will not give any negative references. If defendant complies with the terms of the settlement, upon ex parte application, plaintiff will vacate judgment and dismiss said action. All parties agreed to the terms in open court.

JUDGE DONDERO; CLERK: V. MU; REPORTER: JO ANN BRYCE, #3321 (504)
